title: Selected popup text has low contrast with bright accent colors
scope: Selected by the user on 2026-11-06 after agreeing to keep automatic foreground/background colors, the existing 19 primary/accent families and System/Light/Dark. Fix popup caption readability; other accent-ink/state assessments remain UX-003.
environment: Qt 6.12.0 MSVC 2022 x64, production ColorComboBox in native Windows D3D11 WARP review frames. Physical Android popup contrast not independently measured.
evidence: The selected Accent-popup Green label is #00e676 on rendered #e1e1e1 in Light: 1.28:1. DeepOrange/Purple gives 3.09:1; Brown/Grey gives 2.05:1. The label is normal small text.
Dark default Green on the selected row is 7.95:1, but Purple is 3.41:1. A fix must consider both modes and the actual selected-row overlay.

Source shows selected ColorComboBox and Lists ComboBox delegate foregrounds use root.Material.accent directly. About selected-tab text and focus/slider cues use the same vivid accent family, but their complete rendered-state assessment remains a UX-003 follow-up.
Whole-scene native popup screenshots were used for final measurement to include the highlighted-row surface. Early subtree-only samples were discarded.
reproduction: Use Light theme with Green accent, open the Accent selector and inspect the selected Green caption on its highlighted row.
Run the popup cases in reviews/UX-001/tst_colorroles.qml; final data and representative frames are linked from reviews/UX-001.md.
Repeat with Purple and Grey accents, then Dark/System, using real production popup delegates.
expected: Selected-entry captions remain readable against their actual popup/highlight surfaces without sacrificing the selected vivid swatch/fill. Other controls preserve meaningful focus/state cues.
implementation_notes: Keep user-selected A400/A200 accent fills and picker swatches where practical. Consider a suitable same-family ink tone for text, or another contrasting selection cue, rather than dulling the entire palette.
Measure the actual selected-row background including overlays, not just the popup's base color.
Check Lists selected labels, About selected-tab ink and meaningful slider/focus indicators under UX-003; those additional rendered failures are candidates until measured.
Do not require decorative control borders to meet non-text targets when they are not the identifying cue. Meaningful focus/state cues still need sufficient contrast.
Retain current popup safe-area behavior and Android Back handling; UI-010/UI-016 are not reopened.
acceptance_criteria: Add a permanent automated regression on actual selected popup text and rendered row surfaces; confirm failure before and success after the correction.
Reach 4.5:1 for these small captions across representative palettes and Light/Dark/System, including live palette changes and highlighted/current states.
Preserve the chosen vivid swatches/fills and existing popup geometry/Back behavior.
Validate relevant Android popup rendering with isolated data; record any untested candidate controls separately rather than claiming whole-app contrast coverage.

implementation.summary: ColorComboBox and Lists ComboBox popup delegates use normal theme foreground with a bold current entry. Vivid swatches, highlighted-row behavior, all existing selectors, safe-area geometry and Back policy remain. A font.bold Binding preserves the caller's complete font and follows current-index changes without copying/resetting font size.
implementation.tests: tests/popupcontrast/tst_popupcontrast.qml covers all 19 accents across all three selectors in explicit Light/Dark. Native Windows additionally covers Green/Purple/Grey in both System schemes. Each case measures the actual highlighted surface, current selection after keyboard navigation, changed selection and live palette change; independent alpha/luminance math requires 4.5:1, actual caption pixels, bold current selection, retained caller size and vivid swatches. Dedicated offscreen/native CTest entries run in the normal workflow.
implementation.before_windows: out/ui026/before.txt: original Light/Accent/Green caption assertion fails at 1.242:1 (#00e676 on rendered #e1dde0).
implementation.before_android: out/ui026/android-before/results.json: actual default Light/Green Lists, Accent and Primary selected captions all fail (1.126:1, 1.277:1, 1.277:1); popup-only Back and exact data preservation pass.
implementation.android_test: tests/android/test_popupcontrast.py uses isolated app data and actual popup screenshots. Six profiles cover default bright Green, Dark Purple, Light DeepPurple, neutral Grey and both Android System schemes. It independently identifies rendered caption/background colors, requires 4.5:1, checks Back preserves the drawer and verifies saved row identities/order/checks. Original OS night mode is restored.
implementation.after: Native Android: 42/42 checks pass across all six profiles; caption contrast ranges from 5.329:1 to 12.749:1, popup-only Back preserves the drawer and all saved fixture identities/order/flags remain. Evidence: out/ui026/android-after/results.json and per-profile popup PNG/XML. Offscreen Windows: 116/116 records pass. Full Windows run passes the other 12 suites; native popup suite initially has 14 glyph-core failures (all reached contrast assertions pass). Diagnostic screenshot/log show 13px antialiased glyphs lacking nominal fully covered pixels. Retain offscreen scale 1; enlarge native Windows preview to 2, matching the existing native text-testing approach. Without any further application change, the complete native recheck passes 134/134 in 198.20 seconds. Current reports contain 929 passes across all 13 Windows suites, no failures/skips. Logs: out/ui026/windows-tests.log, glyph-diagnostic.txt, glyph-enlarged.txt and popup-native-recheck.log. All 63 tracked QML sources/templates pass formatting Check; git diff --check passes. No C++ source changes or analyzer rerun.
implementation.apk: dist/QShopper-arm64-debug.apk and dist/QShopper-x86_64-debug.apk built and passed -VerifyPackage (expected runtime present, unused payload absent, QML roots isolated). Shared debug certificate SHA-256: 7c4335c93ec24cb0f92b44ae84ce108180cb299b43ea4e6ef5baafaef7ae029b. ARM64 package SHA-256: 8bde9897fd41eb696a022b4f7df059499b9013e29546e3413a7eff374c511cc7. Logs: out/ui026/arm64-build.log and x86_64-build.log. No physical-device installation by the agent.

resolution.acceptance: 2026-11-06: user tested the updated app and requested: Tested, close ticket and commit changes.
resolution.summary: Use readable normal-theme popup text with a bold current entry in Lists, Accent and Primary. Preserve vivid swatches, caller fonts, safe-area sizing and popup-only Back behavior.
resolution.verification: Current reports contain 929 passing records across all 13 Windows suites and 58 passing native Android checks (42 popup, 16 checked-row Undo). The initial native popup glyph fixture failure and successful scale-2 recheck are explicitly recorded in UI-026. Both APK architectures pass the package contract; all 63 tracked QML/templates pass formatting Check. User confirmation complements automated coverage.
resolution.regression: Permanent test locations and failing-before/passing-after results are recorded in this ticket's implementation/regression section.
resolution.remaining: None within the accepted fix scope. Other accent-ink/focus candidates remain UX-003.
